certification.name: Cellebrite Certified Operator for Inseyets
certification.description: Mobile device unlocking, extraction, decoding and data review with Cellebrite Inseyets. Earned by passing a knowledge test and a practical skills assessment (80% minimum) at the end of the 2-day course; renewed every two years through a recertification exam.
certification.currency_note: Price on request (no public price; registration via Cellebrite Community portal); exam included with the 2-day course, usually taken as a 5-day CCO + CCPA bundle
